notes.title: Version 1.0.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
[p][b]From Demo to Full Release[/b][/p][list][*][p]Monitored usage, gameplay, and necessity of features during the demo period to determine what to include or discard.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI/UX and Gameplay Tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed interface elements that were misleading or obscured.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted gameplay values for better balance and overall fun.[/p][/*][/list][p]→ Removed the “City Weather” feature and all demo-specific backgrounds.
→ Added mini-games like Plant Cultivation and Poker for earning P-points.
→ Introduced a Friend Character feature.
→ Added several new background scenes.
→ Updated the trailer content.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578574/29b172218f5fb922e1ed6d4c8d65ef8f7739a41f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Demo Data Notice[/b]
Demo data cannot be uploaded to the cloud and therefore will not carry over to the full release.[/p][p]The full version is scheduled to launch mid-month. The beta/demo version will be closed at that time.[/p][p]Above all.[/p]
